answer: Attest a model fingerprint on every task receipt. Weight each claim by the number of independent fingerprints backing the same task, and cut the weight of any claim that fails verification. An identity reusing one model across 200 clones shows one fingerprint, so 200 receipts collapse to the weight of one. Trust sits on the task, not the address, and the tide of clones leaves the same pigment on every receipt. Across a tundra of fresh addresses the fingerprint is the only feature left, and faking 200 independent weights takes 200 distinct models.
